#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

double x, y, n;

int main() {
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    double mn = 1e9;
    long long a, b;

    auto lcm = [](long long u, long long v) -> long long {
        return u * v / (__gcd(u, v));
    };

    int lim = (int)n;
    int i = 1;
    while (i <= lim) {
        long long kol = lcm((long long)y, i);
        long long ip = (long long)(x * (kol / y));
        long long div = kol / i;

        if (ip % div == 0) {
            ip /= div;
        } else {
            double vok = (double)ip;
            double pop = (double)div;
            vok = vok / pop + 0.49;
            ip = (long long)vok;
        }

        double ip2 = (double)ip;
        double diff = std::abs(x / y - ip2 / (double)i);
        if (mn > diff) {
            mn = diff;
            a = ip2;
            b = i;
        }
        ++i;
    }

    int d = __gcd(a, b);
    a /= d;
    b /= d;
    cout << a << "/" << b;
    return 0;
}
